# Raytha examples

> Complete websites built on Raytha (the free, open source .NET CMS) by an AI agent with the raytha CLI. Each example is a folder with the brief the agent got, the site as files (content model, Liquid theme, Raytha Functions, seed content, site pages, menus), and an idempotent build.sh that rebuilds it into any Raytha 2.x instance from RAYTHA_URL and RAYTHA_API_KEY. MIT licensed. All content is fictional.

To rebuild an example: run Raytha (Railway template or `docker compose`), create an admin API key, install the CLI (`curl -fsSL https://raytha.com/cli/install.sh | sh`), set RAYTHA_URL and RAYTHA_API_KEY, then `cd <example> && DRY_RUN=1 bash build.sh && bash build.sh`. Requires jq.

## Examples

- [Horizon Summit 2027 (conference-horizon-summit)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/conference-horizon-summit): conference site with 5 content types (speakers, sessions, tracks, sponsors, news), an agenda filtered by day and track via list views and query parameters, speaker and session pages, a tiered sponsor wall, 14 widget templates for site pages, 3 Raytha Functions (.ics downloads, JSON agenda feed), site search, and a members-only Attendee Hub gated by a user group
- [Brief for Horizon Summit](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/conference-horizon-summit/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Groundwork (job-board-groundwork)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/job-board-groundwork): remote job board for climate tech with 2 content types (jobs with a relationship to companies, dropdowns, multiple-select skills, salary number fields, dates, featured checkbox), a job list filtered and searched by category, location type, salary and skill via list views and query parameters, a remote-only saved-filter view, company profile pages listing their jobs, external Apply links, JobPosting JSON-LD for Google for Jobs, 10 widget templates with live counts, 2 Raytha Functions (RSS and JSON Feed), and a members-only salary benchmark hub gated by a user group
- [Brief for Groundwork](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/job-board-groundwork/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Orbitly help center (help-center-orbitly)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/help-center-orbitly): SaaS knowledge base with 3 content types (topics, articles with a relationship to their topic, multiple-select tags, dates, reading time and popular checkbox, and changelog releases with a kind dropdown), a search page filtered by text, topic and tag via a list view and query parameters, search as you type from a Raytha Function returning JSON, related articles by shared tag, prev/next within a topic, TechArticle JSON-LD, a changelog with an RSS Function, a status page with editable widget settings, and 6 widget templates
- [Brief for Orbitly](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/help-center-orbitly/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Atlas Learning (lms-portal-atlas)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/lms-portal-atlas): online course portal with 3 content types (courses with topic and level dropdowns, lessons with a relationship to their course, module, order and a free preview checkbox, and instructors), a catalog filtered by topic and level via a list view and query parameters, course pages with a curriculum grouped by module, members-only lessons gated on the server with CurrentUser.UserGroups so locked lesson text is never sent to visitors, free preview lessons, a members-only My learning dashboard with progress kept in localStorage, a restyled login page, and 8 widget templates
- [Brief for Atlas Learning](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/lms-portal-atlas/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Brightwell Medical Supply (medical-supply-brightwell)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/medical-supply-brightwell): durable medical equipment (DME) provider website with 5 content types (equipment categories, products with a relationship to their category, HCPCS codes, rent or buy and coverage dropdowns, a prescription checkbox and SVG illustrations, patient resources, FAQs and locations), a catalog searched by name or HCPCS code and filtered by category, rent or buy, and coverage via a list view and query parameters, product pages with specification tables and coverage explanations, an FAQ filtered as you type, locations with today's hours highlighted, no payment forms, and 12 widget templates
- [Brief for Brightwell Medical Supply](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/medical-supply-brightwell/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Halftone Awards (awards-halftone)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/awards-halftone): awards program website with 4 content types (categories with a deadline date field, entries with a relationship to their category, year, award dropdown and artwork, and private applications and nominations), an entry gallery and a past winners page as two list views on one content type, category filtering via query parameters, live deadline countdowns, and entry and nomination forms: plain HTML forms that post to 2 Raytha Functions, which check the fields and a honeypot and call API_V1.CreateContentItem to save drafts in content types with unpublished views, then redirect to a thank-you page; 11 widget templates
- [Brief for Halftone Awards](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/awards-halftone/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Commonground Association (association-commonground)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/association-commonground): nonprofit membership association website with 5 content types (tiers with a highlight checkbox, chapters with region dropdown and member counts, events with a relationship to their chapter, a date, and format and audience dropdowns, news, and member resources), a chapter directory with an SVG pin map and region filters, events filtered by format and members-only via list views and query parameters, membership tiers whose Join buttons go to a clearly labeled external placeholder link with no payments on the site, a members-only resource library and dashboard gated on the server with CurrentUser.UserGroups so locked text is never sent to visitors, a restyled login page, and 12 widget templates
- [Brief for Commonground Association](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/association-commonground/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Low Tide Festival (music-festival-lowtide)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/music-festival-lowtide): music festival website with 4 content types (stages with map coordinates and colours, artists with a relationship to their stage, day and genre dropdowns, set start and length numbers and a headliner checkbox, venue places with a kind dropdown and map coordinates, and FAQs), a lineup list view combining day, stage and genre query parameters, a schedule laid out as a CSS grid from set start and length, an inline SVG venue map positioned from content, an FAQ with client-side search, localStorage "My picks" stars, ticket buttons that go to an external placeholder link with no payments on the site, generated SVG artist artwork, and 10 widget templates
- [Brief for Low Tide Festival](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/music-festival-lowtide/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [The Alder Foundation (foundation-alder)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/foundation-alder): grantmaking foundation website with 5 content types (grant programs with deadlines, award ranges and status dropdowns, grantees with a relationship to their program plus year and region dropdowns and award amounts, impact stories, annual reports with total fields, and FAQs), a grantee database filtered by program, year and region via list views and query parameters with a client-side CSV download, impact stories with generated SVG art, annual reports that print to PDF with print CSS, an apply page with eligibility and timeline whose button goes to an external placeholder grants portal, and 14 widget templates
- [Brief for The Alder Foundation](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/foundation-alder/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [The Harbor Ledger (news-harbor-ledger)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/news-harbor-ledger): local news website with 4 content types (sections with colors and icons, authors with beats, articles with a story-type dropdown, breaking, live and featured checkboxes, a reads number and relationships to section and author, and live updates related to their story), a breaking banner driven by a filtered query in the base layout, timestamped live updates with a key-developments filter, a latest-news list filtered by section and story type via query parameters, a most-read list sorted by a seeded reads field, staff pages, RSS and JSON Feed endpoints as Raytha Functions with an optional section filter, and 10 widget templates
- [Brief for The Harbor Ledger](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/news-harbor-ledger/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Maren & Ezra (wedding-maren-ezra)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/wedding-maren-ezra): wedding website with 8 content types (story chapters, events with a day dropdown and guests-only checkbox, hotels with block cut-off dates and shuttle checkboxes, places, FAQs, registry, gallery photos and RSVPs), a weekend schedule with .ics calendar files from a Raytha Function, hotel blocks with countdowns, an RSVP form that posts to a Raytha Function and saves unpublished drafts, a guest page gated to signed-in guests, and 12 widget templates
- [Brief for Maren & Ezra](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/wedding-maren-ezra/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Lantern Ramblers (band-lantern-ramblers)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/band-lantern-ramblers): tribute band website with 5 content types (shows with dates, ticket status dropdowns and poster attachments, setlists with a one-to-one relationship to their show, band members, media and booking requests), tour pages where past shows file themselves by date, a setlist archive filtered by song, song play counts computed in Liquid and in a JSON Raytha Function, and a booking form that posts to a Raytha Function and saves unpublished drafts
- [Brief for Lantern Ramblers](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/band-lantern-ramblers/brief.md): the only input the agent had
- [Postmark Trips (travel-postmark)](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/tree/main/travel-postmark): surprise travel agency website with 5 content types (tiers with a most-popular checkbox and color, reveals with a region dropdown, a one-to-one relationship to their tier and a postcard attachment, reviews with a number rating and gift checkbox, FAQs and trip requests), a reveals archive filtered by region, an average rating and breakdown computed in Liquid, a clue.json Raytha Function, a trip planner form that posts to a Raytha Function and saves unpublished drafts, and 10 widget templates
- [Brief for Postmark Trips](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/travel-postmark/brief.md): the only input the agent had

## For agents building Raytha sites

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/AGENTS.md): CLI output contract, work-from-files loop, dry-runs, `raytha check`, and pitfalls found in real builds (set list view templates explicitly after a schema import, absolute URLs in Functions come from the site's configured URL, prefer CDN assets in themes, dropdown values are objects in Liquid, number fields need `append: ""` before maths, checkbox filters compare to 'true', date fields need `.Value`, Function routes can't start with `api`, `{% include %}` is not supported, checkbox values render as "True", form posts to Functions arrive as key and value pairs)
- [skills/raytha-site-builder/SKILL.md](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/skills/raytha-site-builder/SKILL.md): skill for Cursor and Claude Code that builds a whole site from a brief
- [templates/brief-template.md](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/templates/brief-template.md): fill-in brief format
- [Official raytha CLI skill](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-cli/blob/main/skills/raytha/SKILL.md): command reference rules for agents

## Scripts

- [scripts/build-example.sh](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/scripts/build-example.sh): shared rebuild script driven by an example.json (theme, import order, detail templates, user groups)
- [scripts/new-example.sh](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/scripts/new-example.sh): scaffold an example folder
- [scripts/export-from-instance.sh](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/scripts/export-from-instance.sh): export theme, schema, functions, pages and menus from a running site
- [scripts/capture-screenshots.py](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/scripts/capture-screenshots.py): Playwright screenshots from a shots.json
- [scripts/make-walkthrough.py](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/scripts/make-walkthrough.py): records a short walkthrough video of a built site from a walkthrough.json shot list ([usage](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/scripts/make-walkthrough.md))
- [scripts/scan-secrets.sh](https://github.com/RaythaHQ/raytha-examples/blob/main/scripts/scan-secrets.sh): pre-commit secret scan
